name: Establish Password Registration Session
summary: Completes the password PendingIdentity and grants normal authorization only after durable identity and home workspace establishment.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow == password and durable-identity == resolved and account-status == active and home-workspace == established and workspace-membership == home-only and current-workspace == home and session-capability == identity-ceremony

postconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolved and pending-identity-flow == none and session-capability == authenticated-normal and current-workspace == home
